title: Eventual equality of raw Kan section representatives
statement:
Let $J,F,V,P,Q,i,G,U,A_t,U_t,\theta,B,\beta,D,E$ have the following data.
$J$ is small and filtered, $F:J\to\mathbf{Cat}$ and $V$ is a cocone with
set-colimit object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]
[def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. The $P_j$ and $Q$ are precoverages with
continuous transition functors and cocone legs [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].
$G$ is a set-valued sheaf on $F(i)$, $U\in F(i)$,
$A_t=(F(t))^{-1}G$ and $U_t=F(t)(U)$ for $t\in(i\downarrow J)$.
$\theta_b:A_t\to F(b)_*A_{t'}$ preserves the adjunction units.
$B:(i\downarrow J)\to\operatorname{PSh}(V)$ has left Kan units
$\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^*B_t$ with $[\beta_t B(b)]=[\theta_b\beta_{t'}]$
as arrows at each stage object. $D:(i\downarrow J)\to\mathbf{Sets}$
has isomorphisms $E_t:D_t\simeq A_t(U_t)$ with
$[E_t\theta_b]=[D(b)E_{t'}]$.
For $Y=V_i(U)$ let $\kappa_t:D_t\to(\operatorname{colim}B)(Y)$
be the composite of $E_t$, $\beta_t$, the colimit coprojection, and transport
along $V_t(U_t)=Y$. If $\kappa_t(x)=\kappa_{t'}(x')$, there are
$r\in(i\downarrow J)$ and arrows $b:t\to r$, $b':t'\to r$
with $D(b)(x)=D(b')(x')$.

proof.text: For each t choose the object equality e_t supplied by hκ. Normalize the stage map f_t = E_t β_t followed by transport to B_t(Y), Y = V_i(U). For b:t→t′, Under.w and functor composition give F(b.right)(F(t.hom)U)=F(t′.hom)U. Precompose hβmap by E_t and postcompose hm by β_t′ at these equal objects. Naturality of B(b) along e_t, and invariance of Arrow.mk under equality transport, give f_t B(b)(Y)=D(b) f_t′. Naturality of the colimit coprojection gives κ_t=f_t ι_t(Y). These calculations are proved in Lean by the private Arrow helpers and hf and hk.

Evaluation at Y preserves the presheaf colimit. Apply the filtered-set equality criterion to κ_t(x)=κ_t′(x′), obtaining k and b:t→k, b′:t′→k with B(b)(Y)(f_t(x))=B(b′)(Y)(f_t′(x′)). The preceding compatibility gives f_k(D(b)x)=f_k(D(b′)x′). Cancel the equality transport in f_k, which is an isomorphism of sets, to obtain equality of the β_k unit images of E_k(D(b)x) and E_k(D(b′)x′).

Apply the single-stage Kan-unit relation lemma to the underlying presheaves A_r of the stage inverse images, the natural maps θ(k,r,c).hom, β_k, and F(k.hom)U. Obtain c:k→r with the two transported sections equal. The Arrow equation hm identifies θ_c E_k with D(c) E_r up to equality transport. Injectivity of this transport and E_r implies D(c)(D(b)x)=D(c)(D(b′)x′). Functor.map_comp now yields the desired equality along b≫c and b′≫c. No representative-existence or comparison-isomorphism theorem is used.

theorem raw_section_relations
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ Type u)
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hm : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom))
    (κ : ∀ t : Under i,
      D.obj t ⟶ (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hκ : ∀ t : Under i,
        ∃ e : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U) =
            (V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U,
          κ t =
            (E t).hom ≫ (β t).app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) ≫
              (colimit.ι B t).app
                (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (fun X => (colimit B).obj (op X)) e)) :
    ∀ (t t' : Under i) (x : D.obj t) (x' : D.obj t'),
      κ t x = κ t' x' →
        ∃ (r : Under i) (b : t ⟶ r) (b' : t' ⟶ r), D.map b x = D.map b' x'
